title: चतुर्विंशत्यधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 224 · Mandapala returns to his family

summary.en: Mandapala, anxious for his sons, is taunted by his new mate Lapita. When the fire has passed he returns to Jarita and the fledglings, who receive him coldly at first, and he explains that he had made sure of their safety.
summary.kn: ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಚಿಂತಿಸುವ ಮಂದಪಾಲನನ್ನು ಹೊಸ ಸಂಗಾತಿ ಲಪಿತೆ ಹಂಗಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಅಗ್ನಿ ದಾಟಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವನು ಜರಿತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮರಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಮರಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಅವರು ಮೊದಲು ತಣ್ಣಗೆ ಸ್ವಾಗತಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ, ತಾನು ಅವರ ಸುರಕ್ಷೆಯನ್ನು ಖಚಿತಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದೆನೆಂದು ಅವನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: पुत्रों के लिए चिन्तित मन्दपाल को उनकी नई संगिनी लपिता ताने देती है। आग के चले जाने पर वे जरिता और बच्चों के पास लौटते हैं, जो पहले उदासीनता से मिलते हैं, और वे समझाते हैं कि उन्होंने उनकी सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित कर ली थी।
summary.te: కుమారుల కోసం చింతిస్తున్న మందపాలుని కొత్త సహచరి లపిత ఎగతాళి చేస్తుంది. అగ్ని దాటిపోయాక అతడు జరిత, పిల్లల వద్దకు తిరిగివస్తాడు; వారు మొదట చల్లగా స్వాగతిస్తారు, తాను వారి రక్షణను ముందే నిర్ధారించానని అతడు వివరిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: மைந்தர்களுக்காகக் கவலைப்படும் மந்தபாலரைப் புதிய துணை லபிதை ஏளனம் செய்கிறாள். தீ கடந்தபின் அவர் ஜரிதையிடமும் குஞ்சுகளிடமும் திரும்ப, அவர்கள் முதலில் குளிர்ச்சியாக வரவேற்கிறார்கள்; அவர்கள் பாதுகாப்பைத் தாம் உறுதி செய்திருந்ததாக அவர் விளக்குகிறார்.
summary.ml: തന്റെ പുത്രന്മാരെക്കുറിച്ച് ആകുലനായ മന്ദപാലൻ, പുതിയ ഇണയായ ലപിതയുടെ പരിഹാസം നേരിടുന്നു. തീ കടന്നുപോയ ശേഷം അദ്ദേഹം ജരിതയുടെയും പക്ഷികളുടെയും അടുത്തേക്ക് മടങ്ങുന്നു; ആദ്യം അവർ തണുപ്പോടെ സ്വീകരിക്കുന്നു, അവരുടെ സുരക്ഷ ഉറപ്പാക്കിയിരുന്നതായി അദ്ദേഹം വിശദീകരിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 1.224; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Aug 22 2026

sections.title: खाण्डवदाहपर्व
sections.titleEn: Khandavadaha Parva (Burning of the Khandava forest)

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
मन्दपालोऽपि कौरव्य चिन्तयानः सुतांस्तदा ।
उक्तवानप्यशीतांशुं नैव स स्म न तप्यते ॥

meaning.en: Mandapala too, O Kaurava, brooded over his sons at that time; though he had already spoken to the fire, he could not stop burning with worry.

verses.text:
स तप्यमानः पुत्रार्थे लपितामिदमब्रवीत् ।
कथं न्वशक्ताः प्लवने लपिते मम पुत्रकाः ॥

meaning.en: Tormented for his sons, he lamented, "How will my little ones, who cannot yet fly, escape as the fire comes?"

verses.text:
वर्धमाने हुतवहे वाते शीघ्रं प्रवायति ।
असमर्था विमोक्षाय भविष्यन्ति ममात्मजाः ॥

meaning.en: "With the fire growing and the wind blowing hard, my children will be unable to get free.

verses.text:
कथं न्वशक्ता त्राणाय माता तेषां तपस्विनी ।
भविष्यत्यसुखाविष्टा पुत्रत्राणमपश्यती ॥

meaning.en: And how will their poor mother, unable to rescue them, bear it, sunk in misery and seeing no way to save her sons?

verses.text:
कथं नु सरणेऽशक्तान्पतने च ममात्मजान् ।
संतप्यमाना अभितो वाशमानाभिधावती ॥

meaning.en: How will she manage, burning with grief, running to and fro and crying out around my sons, who can neither run nor fly?

verses.text:
जरितारिः कथं पुत्रः सारिसृक्वः कथं च मे ।
स्तम्बमित्रः कथं द्रोणः कथं सा च तपस्विनी ॥

meaning.en: How is my son Jaritari? How is Sarisrikva? How are Stambamitra and Drona? How is that poor mother of theirs?"

verses.text:
लालप्यमानं तमृषिं मन्दपालं तथा वने ।
लपिता प्रत्युवाचेदं सासूयमिव भारत ॥

meaning.en: As the sage Mandapala wailed so in the forest, O Bharata, Lapita answered him with something like jealousy.

verses.text:
न ते सुतेष्ववेक्षास्ति तानृषीनुक्तवानसि ।
तेजस्विनो वीर्यवन्तो न तेषां ज्वलनाद्भयम् ॥

meaning.en: "You have no concern for your sons: you told those sages, who are so mighty and brave, that they need not fear the fire.

verses.text:
तथाग्नौ ते परीत्ताश्च त्वया हि मम संनिधौ ।
प्रतिश्रुतं तथा चेति ज्वलनेन महात्मना ॥

meaning.en: "You entrusted them to Agni in my presence, and the great Agni promised it would be so.

verses.text:
लोकपालोऽनृतां वाचं न तु वक्ता कथंचन ।
समर्थास्ते च वक्तारो न ते तेष्वस्ति मानसम् ॥

meaning.en: "A guardian of the world would never speak falsely, and your sons are able to speak up for themselves; the truth is your heart is not with them.

verses.text:
तामेव तु ममामित्रीं चिन्तयन्परितप्यसे ।
ध्रुवं मयि न ते स्नेहो यथा तस्यां पुराभवत् ॥

meaning.en: "You are tormented thinking only of that rival of mine; surely you no longer love me as you once did.

verses.text:
न हि पक्षवता न्याय्यं निःस्नेहेन सुहृज्जने ।
पीड्यमान उपद्रष्टुं शक्तेनात्मा कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: "It is not right for one who has wings to stand by, loveless, while friends and family are being hurt, when he is able to help.

verses.text:
गच्छ त्वं जरितामेव यदर्थं परितप्यसे ।
चरिष्याम्यहमप्येका यथा कापुरुषे तथा ॥

meaning.en: "Go to Jarita, the one you are so troubled about; I will live alone, as a woman does with a worthless man."

verses.text: मन्दपाल उवाच

meaning.en: Mandapala said:

verses.text:
नाहमेवं चरे लोके यथा त्वमभिमन्यसे ।
अपत्यहेतोर्विचरे तच्च कृच्छ्रगतं मम ॥

meaning.en: I do not live in the world as you suppose; I wander for the sake of offspring, and that now has fallen into peril.

verses.text:
भूतं हित्वा भविष्येऽर्थे योऽवलम्बेत मन्दधीः ।
अवमन्येत तं लोको यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु ॥

meaning.en: A fool who gives up what is at hand to cling to what may come is despised by the world; do as you please.

verses.text:
एष हि ज्वलमानोऽग्निर्लेलिहानो महीरुहान् ।
द्वेष्यं हि हृदि संतापं जनयत्यशिवं मम ॥

meaning.en: This blazing fire, licking the trees, brings an ugly, hateful burning pain to my heart.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
तस्माद्देशादतिक्रान्ते ज्वलने जरिता ततः ।
जगाम पुत्रकानेव त्वरिता पुत्रगृद्धिनी ॥

meaning.en: When the fire had passed beyond that place, Jarita, eager for her sons, hurried back to them.

verses.text:
सा तान्कुशलिनः सर्वान्निर्मुक्ताञ्जातवेदसः ।
रोरूयमाणा कृपणा सुतान्दृष्टवती वने ॥

meaning.en: She saw all her sons safe, released from the fire, and, weeping in her misery, she looked at them in the forest.

verses.text:
अश्रद्धेयतमं तेषां दर्शनं सा पुनः पुनः ।
एकैकशश्च तान्पुत्रान्क्रोशमानान्वपद्यत ॥

meaning.en: She could hardly believe her eyes, and she went to her sons again and again, one by one, as they cried out.

verses.text:
ततोऽभ्यगच्छत्सहसा मन्दपालोऽपि भारत ।
अथ ते सर्व एवैनं नाभ्यनन्दन्त वै सुताः ॥

meaning.en: Then Mandapala also arrived suddenly, O Bharata, but none of the sons welcomed him.

verses.text:
लालप्यमानमेकैकं जरितां च पुनः पुनः ।
नोचुस्ते वचनं किंचित्तमृषिं साध्वसाधु वा ॥

meaning.en: Though he spoke to each of them and to Jarita again and again, they said not a single word to the sage, kind or unkind.

verses.text: मन्दपाल उवाच

meaning.en: Mandapala said:

verses.text:
ज्येष्ठः सुतस्ते कतमः कतमस्तदनन्तरः ।
मध्यमः कतमः पुत्रः कनिष्ठः कतमश्च ते ॥

meaning.en: Which of your sons is the eldest? Which comes next, which is the middle one, and which the youngest?

verses.text:
एवं ब्रुवन्तं दुःखार्तं किं मां न प्रतिभाषसे ।
कृतवानस्मि हव्याशे नैव शान्तिमितो लभे ॥

meaning.en: I am speaking to you in distress; why do you not answer me? I made my appeal to Agni, and still I cannot find peace.

verses.text: जरितोवाच

meaning.en: Jarita said:

verses.text:
किं ते ज्येष्ठे सुते कार्यं किमनन्तरजेन वा ।
किं च ते मध्यमे कार्यं किं कनिष्ठे तपस्विनि ॥

meaning.en: What business have you with the eldest son, or the next one, or the middle one, or the youngest, poor man?

verses.text:
यस्त्वं मां सर्वशो हीनामुत्सृज्यासि गतः पुरा ।
तामेव लपितां गच्छ तरुणीं चारुहासिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: You abandoned me entirely and went off before; go to that very woman you lamented over, the young one with the lovely smile.

verses.text: मन्दपाल उवाच

meaning.en: Mandapala said:

verses.text:
न स्त्रीणां विद्यते किंचिदन्यत्र पुरुषान्तरात् ।
सापत्नकमृते लोके भवितव्यं हि तत्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Nothing matters more to women than a rival wife, except in the world's eyes it must be so; there is no other reason.

verses.text:
सुव्रतापि हि कल्याणी सर्वलोकपरिश्रुता ।
अरुन्धती पर्यशङ्कद्वसिष्ठमृषिसत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: Even Arundhati, devoted to her vows, noble and famed through all the worlds, doubted the sage Vasishtha, best of seers.

verses.text:
विशुद्धभावमत्यन्तं सदा प्रियहिते रतम् ।
सप्तर्षिमध्यगं वीरमवमेने च तं मुनिम् ॥

meaning.en: He was utterly pure, always set on her good and her pleasure, a hero standing among the seven seers, and still she slighted him.

verses.text:
अपध्यानेन सा तेन धूमारुणसमप्रभा ।
लक्ष्यालक्ष्या नाभिरूपा निमित्तमिव लक्ष्यते ॥

meaning.en: By that ill thought she became like a smoky, reddish glow, seen and unseen, small and ill-formed, like a bad omen.

verses.text:
अपत्यहेतोः संप्राप्तं तथा त्वमपि मामिह ।
इष्टमेवंगते हित्वा सा तथैव च वर्तसे ॥

meaning.en: You too have treated me as she did, though I came here for the sake of children; you reject me, who am blameless, and act just as she did.

verses.text:
नैव भार्येति विश्वासः कार्यः पुंसा कथंचन ।
न हि कार्यमनुध्याति भार्या पुत्रवती सती ॥

meaning.en: A man should never put his faith in a wife merely because she is a wife; once she has sons, a good wife does not think of her husband's purpose.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
ततस्ते सर्व एवैनं पुत्राः सम्यगुपासिरे ।
स च तानात्मजान्राजन्नाश्वासयितुमारभत् ॥

meaning.en: Then all the sons properly honored him, and, O king, he began to comfort his children.
